credential_secret_service_account.scope: ambient credentials denied; at most one explicitly supplied qualification-only parent auth source, hidden from sandboxed subprocesses by sandbox.credentials.envVars deny (subprocess scrub mode is disabled)

delegation.scope: scripted qualification-owned stdio MCP delegate only; native Agent/cross-session messaging/remote scheduling excluded

external_mutation.scope: qualification-owned stdio MCP issue mutations plus run-owned workspace effects; no executor native network or Unix-socket route

issue_evidence_store.scope: qualification-owned stdio MCP only; private state/log/server/config remain under denied harness-private root and are not exposed to executor Bash

network_remote_service.scope: native executor network denied by restricted sandbox; provider control plane is outside tool capability

process_execution.scope: Bash under fail-closed restricted sandbox whose write scope is the run project only; command-family permission patterns are approval convenience, not the containment boundary

workspace_mutation.scope: run-owned project only for native Write/Edit (project-scoped permission rules, no bare allow, .claude write-denied) and for Bash (sandbox allowWrite is the project); containment/MCP control files live outside the workspace under the denied harness-private root; no other host path, including /tmp outside the project, is writable

workspace_read_search_list.scope: native Read/Glob/Grep: run-owned project including the installed skill package only (permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories plus adapter-generated project-scoped rules; reads elsewhere are refused); Bash: sandboxed, host user, custody, run-state and /proc roots denied, other host paths (for example /usr, /etc and /tmp) remain visible to the sandboxed shell read-only and are never writable

tool:Skill.scope: native Skill surface; governed by semantic capability decision and substrate containment

tool:Read.scope: native Read surface; run-project-scoped by permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories and adapter-generated project-scoped permission rules; bare grants refused

tool:Glob.scope: native Glob surface; run-project-scoped by permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories and adapter-generated project-scoped permission rules; bare grants refused

tool:Grep.scope: native Grep surface; run-project-scoped by permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories and adapter-generated project-scoped permission rules; bare grants refused

tool:Edit.scope: native Edit surface; run-project-scoped by adapter-generated project-scoped permission rules (no bare allow); .claude write-denied

tool:Write.scope: native Write surface; run-project-scoped by adapter-generated project-scoped permission rules (no bare allow); .claude write-denied

tool:Bash.scope: native Bash surface; governed by semantic capability decision and substrate containment

runtime_capability:interrupt_receipt_v1.scope: runtime message/interrupt lifecycle support; no native messaging tool admitted

runtime_capability:interrupt_cancel_queu.scope: runtime queued-message cancellation support; no native messaging tool admitted

runtime_capability:msg_lifecycle_v1.scope: runtime message lifecycle support; native messaging tools excluded

runtime_capability:mcp_read_resource_v1.scope: runtime MCP protocol support; strict profile admits only the named qualification stdio server

runtime_capability:mcp_tool_ui_meta_v1.scope: tool metadata support; exact init tools still authoritative

messaging_socket_path.scope: runtime-created cross-session socket; restricted sandbox Unix-socket allow-list excludes it

auto_memory_write.scope: runtime auto-memory surface; disabled and isolated to fresh run-owned HOME; admission must prove no external write

mcp_server:ssdp70.scope: single strict run-owned qualification stdio MCP server; exact identity and connected runtime observation required

tool:mcp__ssdp70__issue_create.scope: create issue only in qualification-owned private stand-in

tool:mcp__ssdp70__issue_comment.scope: comment only in qualification-owned private stand-in
